payload.name: IncludeEventKindForCurrentActivitySearches
payload.description: When a question asks about a person's current ongoing activity (reading, watching, working on), search event memories as well as state memories before concluding no information.
content: When the question asks what someone is currently reading, watching, working on, or otherwise doing as an ongoing activity, include memory_kind 'event' in the search; do not restrict to 'state' only.
If the first search returns no evidence matching the activity, retry with memory_kinds extended to include 'event' (and 'state' if excluded) before answering 'No information available'.
Stop as soon as a memory directly naming the activity and the subject is found; do not exhaustively search all memory kinds when evidence is sufficient.

solves: General failure: retrieval is restricted to state memories for questions about ongoing activities, causing event-stored activities to be missed. Applies when a user asks what someone is currently reading, watching, working on, or otherwise doing; include the event memory kind in the search. Does not apply to questions about stable attributes or preferences, and does not mandate exhaustive search when evidence is already sufficient.
